metadata.description:
A collection of the annual reports & Form 10-K to stockholders of NVIDIA Corporation (Ticker: NVDA).

The corporation, an American multinational technology firm founded in 1993, provides graphics chips for use in smartphones, tablets and computers in markets worldwide.  The company has been publicly traded since January 2, 1999 and is s headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
